---
title: "Projects"
---

## Time-Series Analytics for Smart Manufacturing

Developed machine learning and deep learning models for forecasting, classification, pattern recognition, and decision support in smart manufacturing systems.

## Manufacturing Time-Series Analytics in NSF-Funded Research

Led the manufacturing time-series analytics task in NSF-funded research at West Virginia University, with emphasis on experimental evaluation of algorithms for manufacturing data streams.

## Real-Time Defect Detection in Robotic Assembly

Contributed to machine learning frameworks for real-time defect detection and classification in robotic assembly lines, connecting sensor data with quality monitoring and process feedback.

## Federated Learning and Blockchain for Smart Manufacturing

Current work on integrating federated learning, blockchain, and ML/DL models for secure and collaborative manufacturing systems where data privacy and trust are central constraints.

## Rocket Assembly Line Testbed as a Service

Contributed to research on data acquisition strategies and testbed-as-a-service frameworks for rocket assembly lines, supporting repeatable experimentation and manufacturing analytics research.
